_about: Lunch and dinner around Topsail for the Island Edition's Lunch & Dinner section. render.py reads this file; nothing here is typed into a page by hand.
Researched 2026-10-21 (scratch research, every value read that day from the source named). Ratings: Wanderlog's Google and Tripadvisor figures unless ratings_source says Topsail Guide.
hours: weekday -> list of 'HH:MM-HH:MM' spans (24h, Eastern). A missing weekday is closed. '?' means the hours could not be read: the page says call first.
status: open | call (may be closed for the season, or temporarily closed: listed under Call first, never recommended) | closed (gone for good: never shown).
pick: true for the paper's own picks (listed first). weekly: a special that runs every week on that weekday, with weekly_source.
facebook: the page local/fb_specials.py reads for the day's posts.
Public repo: business details only. No reader names.

places.name: Daddy Mac's Beach Grille
places.style: Oceanfront seafood, crab cakes and steaks by the Surf City pier; full bar
places.hours_note: Sunday is brunch only (its site: "closed for Sunday dinner" this fall). Closed Monday.
places.reviews: Reviewers love the beachfront setting, the friendly staff and fresh ingredients; a few call the food average but say the ocean view makes up for it.
places.order: sliders, Maryland-style crab cakes

places.name: Shaka Taco
places.style: Beachside tacos, nachos, wings and quesadillas; dog-friendly patio
places.hours_note: Sunday closes at 3 PM per its site's data (Wanderlog and its Facebook page say 8 PM).
places.reviews: Generous portions, big flavors and quick service on a laid-back patio; the review summary names no complaints.
places.order: shrimp quesadilla, pork taco, carne asada, nachos

places.name: SurfDog Bites & Brews
places.address: 204-A N New River Dr (Treasure Coast Square), Surf City
places.style: Hot dogs, burgers, fish and chicken sandwiches, salads; rotating drafts
places.hours_note: Closed Sunday; Monday is lunch only.
places.reviews: Mixed: the mahi sandwich, Cajun shrimp, fried chicken sandwiches and salads win praise, while some found the hot dogs disappointing, the service slow or the prices high for a family.
places.order: mahi fish sandwich, Cajun shrimp, fried chicken sandwich

weekly.Tue: Spaghetti with meat sauce, salad and garlic bread
weekly.Wed: Tacos with a side and a fountain drink; Family Night, kids 12 and under eat half price with a free dessert, 4 PM to close
weekly.Thu: 8 oz ribeye, twice-baked potato and a vegetable
weekly.Fri: Blackened mahi tacos with a side and a drink

places.weekly_source: its own home page (undated weekly specials), read 2026-10-21

places.name: Sears Landing
places.address: 806 Roland Ave, Surf City (on the ICW at the high-rise bridge)
places.style: Dockside seafood on the waterway; covered deck and outdoor bar

weekly.Wed: Wing & Wine Night: half-price wings and half-price wine

places.hours_note: Its site says '8:00 am until...'; Wanderlog and its Facebook page give 8 PM.
places.reviews: A well-loved local spot with friendly, attentive service and consistently fresh food; a few mention occasional service lapses.
places.order: crab cake sandwich, grilled shrimp, West Indies seafood roll, key lime pie

places.name: Max's Pizza
places.style: Family pizza, pasta, subs and burgers
places.hours_note: Closed Monday and Tuesday.
places.reviews: Generous toppings, a crispy crust and friendly service, with the garlic cheese bread the standout starter; salads and pasta get mixed reviews.
places.order: garlic cheese bread, cheese or pepperoni pizza

places.name: Coastal Wing & Spirits Co.
places.style: Wings, burgers and pub food; plenty of TVs, inside and out
places.hours_note: Hours from Wanderlog (its own site blocks readers); its Facebook page, not updated since 2024, shows 11:30 AM every day.
places.reviews: A favorite of locals and visitors for good food, a lively room and quick service even for big groups; the summary names no complaints.
places.order: Bavarian pretzel with beer cheese, wings (Korean Thai chili), BLT ahi tuna tacos

places.name: Island Delights
places.address: 316 N New River Dr, Surf City
places.style: 1950s-style diner and soda shop: burgers, hot dogs, ice cream
places.hours_note: Fall hours posted on its Facebook page Oct 23. Closes for the winter (NC Tripping); the closing date is not published.
places.hours_source: own Facebook page (hours updated Oct 23, 2026), read 2026-10-23
places.reviews: Families love the burgers, the ice cream and the working jukeboxes; friendly and reasonably priced, busy at peak times.
places.order: cheeseburger 'delight style', Carolina-style hot dog

places.name: The Patio at the Surf
places.style: Brunch and lunch, craft cocktails; evening tapas Thursday to Sunday
places.hours_note: Tapas Thu and Sun 3-8 PM, Fri-Sat 3-11 PM. Its site also says 6 AM in places, and gives two addresses (Triton Ln and Charlie Medlin Dr).

places.name: New York Corner Deli
places.style: Deli sandwiches and NY-style hot dogs; breakfast and lunch, patio
places.hours_note: Hours from Wanderlog only; its website is gone.
places.reviews: Mixed: some love the pastrami on rye and the hot dog, others find it ordinary, and the patio draws complaints about flies.
places.order: pastrami on rye, NY-style hot dog

places.name: Surf City Ocean Pier Grill
places.address: 112 S Shore Dr, Surf City (on the pier)
places.style: Casual grill and ice cream on the fishing pier
places.hours_note: The pier is open through Nov 30; the grill's own off-season hours are not published.

places.name: Topsail Steamer Seafood
places.style: Seafood steam pots to pick up and cook at the house
places.hours_note: Pickup hours from Wanderlog; November hours not confirmed.
places.reviews: Generous, fresh seafood with simple cooking instructions and helpful staff, a fun family dinner; one reviewer found the prep expectations unclear.

places.name: Shuckin' Shack Oyster Bar
places.style: Oyster bar and casual seafood; outdoor family seating
places.hours_note: No off-season hours posted.
places.hours_source: own Facebook page (hours updated May 2026) and Wanderlog, read 2026-10-23
places.reviews: Fresh seafood, attentive service and cold beer, with a fairly priced lobster roll; the summary names no complaints.
places.order: local oysters, grilled fish tacos, lobster roll, clam chowder

places.name: Margaritas Mexican Grill & Cantina
places.address: 204 N New River Dr, Surf City
places.style: Mexican grill and cantina
places.hours_note: Monday and Tuesday hours come from a 2022 Visit Pender article (Wanderlog's are garbled); its Facebook page, not updated since 2023, shows an hour earlier each night.
places.reviews: Welcoming staff, excellent margaritas and a wide menu; the summary names no complaints.
places.order: Pollo Margarita, fajitas

places.name: Fancy Sushi Asian Fusion
places.address: 124 N New River Dr, Surf City
places.style: Sushi and Chinese; takeout
places.hours_note: Tuesday: its site lists hours; its Facebook page and Wanderlog say closed.
places.reviews: Fresh, flavorful sushi and generous portions in a clean room; some find the Chinese dishes bland.
places.order: Angel Hair roll, krab rangoon

places.name: Santorini Greek & Italian Bistro
places.style: Greek and Italian, steaks and gyros; full bar
places.hours_note: Dinner only; closed Sunday and Monday. 'Hours subject to change.'
places.reviews: Warm bread with garlic butter, attentive servers and friendly owners in a cozy room; the summary names no complaints.
places.order: spanakopita, Greek spaghetti, lobster ravioli, shrimp scampi

places.name: Low Tide Steakhouse & SandBar
places.style: Steakhouse and seafood with a salad bar; takes reservations
places.hours_note: Its site gives two opening times (11 and 11:30); the later one is shown.
places.reviews: Steaks cooked right, a fresh salad bar and warm staff; the loaded fries and grilled salmon get mixed opinions.
places.order: steaks, seared tuna, lobster bisque

places.name: Maine Lobstah Shack
places.style: Maine-style lobster shack; outdoor seats with sunset over the bridge
places.hours_note: Off-season: Thursday to Sunday only, early dinner.
places.reviews: Rave reviews for generous, fresh lobster ('some of the best outside New England') and a warm welcome from the owner; no complaints in the summary.
places.order: lobster roll, lobster grilled cheese, lobster bisque

places.name: Surf City Smash
places.address: 100 Charlie Medlin Dr Ste B, Surf City
places.style: Smash burgers and cheesesteaks
places.reviews: A must for burger and cheesesteak fans; the house tortilla chips are 'amazing and addictive' and the staff kind; no complaints in the summary.
places.order: N. Topsail burger, ribeye Philly, tortilla chips

places.name: Margherita Pizza Co
places.address: 112 Charlie Medlin Dr Unit A, Surf City
places.style: Wood-oven pizza and Italian; wine bar, gluten-free options
places.hours_note: Winter hours shown (the start date is not published); it may close early on quiet nights. Phones answered after 5 PM.
places.reviews: Some of the best wood-oven pizza in the area, with good sangria and meatballs; a few mention noise at peak times.
places.order: Queen Margherita, chicken meatballs, tiramisu

places.name: Beach Shop & Grill
places.style: Southern coastal seafood, beachy-upscale; wine list, patio, dogs welcome
places.hours_note: Closed Monday to Wednesday; lunch Friday and Saturday only; Sunday brunch 9-3. First come, first served. Menu: https://beachshopandgrill.com/menu
places.reviews: Careful plating, exceptional service and good cocktails; the one complaint is noise.
places.order: crab cakes, steak, key lime meringue pie

places.name: Breezeway Restaurant
places.address: 634 Channel Blvd, Topsail Beach (on the sound)
places.style: Old-school soundside seafood with sunset views
places.hours_note: Still promoting dinner on Facebook Oct 19 ("Doors open at 5 PM"), with no closing notice as of Oct 23. Last fall it never posted a closing date either: open only Thu and Sat in the week of Oct 28, 2025, a ticketed oyster roast Dec 13, reopened Apr 2. Hours may be cut back by November.
places.hours_source: own contact page (no season dates), read 2026-10-23
places.reviews: Mixed: beautiful water views and friendly staff, but some find the food lacking; sit outside after 7.
places.order: shrimp and grits, hush puppies

places.name: Cora's Isle-End Deli
places.style: Creative deli: sandwiches, wraps, subs, salads, soups
places.hours_note: Fall 2026 hours: closed Tuesday.
places.reviews: A charming, creative local deli with memorable flavors and upbeat staff; bring napkins. No complaints in the summary.
places.order: werewolf wrap, shrimp and sausage sub

places.name: Jolly Roger Pier Grill
places.address: 803 Ocean Blvd, Topsail Beach (on the pier)
places.style: Pier grill: breakfast and lunch sandwiches over the ocean
places.hours_note: Friday to Sunday only.

places.name: Beach Bum's Pizza Bar & Grill
places.style: Pizza, bar and grill with a patio; trivia, karaoke, weekend music
places.hours_note: Breakfast 8-11 Thursday to Sunday.
places.reviews: Mixed: friendly staff and good outdoor space, but food and service are called inconsistent and some dishes overpriced.
places.order: pizza, pulled pork sandwich

places.name: Splash by the Sea
places.address: 790 New River Inlet Rd, North Topsail Beach
places.style: Ocean-view restaurant and bar; gluten-friendly options
places.hours_note: Its Facebook page (updated January 2026) shows noon openings and Sunday 9:30 AM-3 PM instead; call to check.
places.hours_source: Wanderlog and its own site as Topsail Guide quotes it, read 2026-10-23
places.reviews: Food, drinks and ocean views called exceptional, with friendly staff; the summary names no complaints.
places.order: marinated salmon, Caprese chicken, Toni's tenders

places.name: Seaview Pier Restaurant
places.address: 124 Fishing Pier Ln, North Topsail Beach
places.style: Pier restaurant: burgers, sandwiches, fried seafood, breakfast
places.hours_note: Takes a winter break (NC Tripping); the start date is not published.
places.reviews: Fresh seafood in big portions with quick service, 'upscale fast food'; the indoor seats have no view.
places.order: fried shrimp, BBQ sandwich

places.name: Ocean's Edge Restaurant
places.address: 2000 New River Inlet Rd (St. Regis resort), North Topsail Beach
places.style: Seafood with 7th-floor ocean views
places.hours_note: Listings disagree (Thursday to Saturday, or Tuesday to Saturday, 4-9 PM) and two mark it temporarily closed; call before going.
places.hours_source: Restaurant Guru, Topsail Guide and Wanderlog, read 2026-10-23
places.reviews: The 7th-floor view (with binoculars for dolphins) wins praise; some say the room needs updating.

places.name: Riverview Cafe
places.style: Southern seafood house on the water; riverside picnic tables
places.hours_note: About 25 minutes from the Surf City bridge.
places.hours_source: own Facebook page (Page hours and its daily 'open until 8:30' / 'until 9' posts), read 2026-10-23
places.reviews: Big portions of fresh, flavorful food at fair prices; the hush puppies, slaw and hot crab dip stand out.
places.order: flounder, steamed shrimp, deviled crab, hot crab dip, lemon pie

places.name: Spiaggia Ristobar
places.style: Italian restaurant and bar
places.hours_note: Its own site's hours (listings show later closing).
places.reviews: From review snippets (no summary exists): called a gem, with pizza 'best outside of Long Island' and melt-in-your-mouth calamari.
places.order: fried calamari, penne vodka, pappardelle with braised beef

places.name: Italian Bistro
places.style: Italian-American pizza and pasta; family spot
places.hours_note: Its page gives two closing times; the earlier is shown.
places.reviews: Good pizza, accommodating staff and a clean room, and said to have improved over time.
places.order: buffalo chicken pizza, garlic cheese bread

weekly.Mon: Large 18-inch pizza with up to 3 toppings, $18.99
weekly.Wed: Medium 14-inch pizza with up to 3 toppings, $16.99

places.name: Burrito Shak
places.address: 2761 NC-210 E, Unit A (Publix center), Hampstead
places.style: Quick burritos, tacos, bowls and nachos
places.hours_note: The chain calls this its Surf City store; it is on NC 210 in Hampstead.
places.reviews: Consistently good, fresh food and friendly service even when busy; some report slow to-go orders.
places.order: fish tacos, loaded nachos

places.name: Smoky Tony's BBQ
places.style: Full-service barbecue; house-made banana pudding
places.hours_note: Closed Sunday.
places.reviews: From review snippets (no summary exists): a local favorite with plenty of food and desserts 'to die for'.
places.order: baby back ribs, brisket, banana pudding

places.name: Surf City Barbeque
places.style: Barbecue
places.hours_note: Closed for good: its site says 'After 13 years, we have closed the doors at Surf City BBQ' (checked 2026-10-21). Listings still show it.
